gloss: difficulty finding a job; tight job market

definitions.gloss: difficulty finding a job; tight job market
definitions.explanation: A situation in which there are few openings for many job seekers, seen from the job seekers' side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{就職難|しゅうしょくなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧だった。
examples.english: Back then, jobs were hard to find.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{就職難|しゅうしょくなん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Because of the recession, jobs remain scarce.

examples.japanese: {就職難|しゅうしょくなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the tight job market, more students went on to graduate school.

notes:
⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧ (finding employment) + ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficulty). The opposite situation, where employers cannot find workers, is ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧.

- {就職難|しゅうしょくなん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: an era of scarce jobs
